race.comment: In a race where most of these struggle to win, DUSTY'S DEEL (7) gets his chance. Fitter for two runs back and placed at each, the latest led until the final stages before being run down. Fitter again and extra trip suits. Won only try course which was at this trip and with the claim will take catching again. I COULD DO BETTER (11) was a winner two back then fourth last time in a similar race. Placed 2/3 this circuit and looks hard to hold out on recent form. PROVEN RECORD (10) placed at Wangaratta two back then disappointed at Moe last week. On the quick back-up but best figures stack up. FRANK EXPRESS (1) made his hurdle debut last time and didn't finish. Prior to that though wasn't far away in this sort of grade so back to the flat is worth keeping an eye on. HIDE YOUR ASSETS (12) has been thereabouts the last couple and can feature on best figures.
